description: Trigger evals for dv:gauntlet (staged adversarial code-review loop over a diff, fixes+commits by default). Hard near-misses in no_trigger: 'review this PR' is a one-shot builtin review, not the convergent loop; plan-critique phrasing belongs to dv:critique (a plan pre-code, not a diff); CLAUDE.md review is dv:review-claudemd; a security-only audit is /security-review. See tooling/evals/README.md.

queries.q: Run the gauntlet on my feature branch.
Do an adversarial review of this diff and fix what survives.
Red-team the change I just made before I merge it.
Try to break my change, then patch the real issues.
Run the codex review loop on this branch until it approves.
Review my branch, fix the findings, and commit them across rounds.
Keep reviewing this change until it survives.
Drive an adversarial find-refute-fix loop on my diff to convergence.
Autonomously review my code change and commit the fixes.
Run the staged review loop on my branch and only bug me at the end.
Critique my plan to migrate the database before I start coding.
Review this pull request.
Improve my CLAUDE.md for stale rules.
Do a security audit of the auth module.
Stress-test this approach before I implement it.
Summarize this Reddit thread: https://www.reddit.com/r/programming/comments/abc/.
Write a handoff for this session.
Name this tmux window.
What's the current price of a Raspberry Pi 5 right now?
Fetch this tweet: https://x.com/user/status/123.
